name: setup-python
description: 安装并设置指定版本的 Python 运行环境，支持 x86/ARM 架构、构建命令执行与依赖管理。

scripts.package-main: ncc build src/main.ts -o dist && shx mv dist/src/main.js dist/main.js
scripts.package-stop: ncc build src/stop.ts -o dist && shx mv dist/src/stop.js dist/stop.js
scripts.compile: npm run build && npm run package-main && npm run package-stop
scripts.zip: rimraf dist/src && rimraf  dist/tests  && node scripts/pack-setup-python.js
scripts.package: npm run compile && npm run zip

author: hjb
